units: <cite ref="Berakhot 24a:21">Ber. 24ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>בכ׳</he> (Ms. F. <he>בכִיסְתֵיה</he>) in the bag (of the T’fillin).

<cite ref="Shabbat 105b:1">Sabb. 105ᵇ</cite> top <he>דעבדה כי׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>כי כסתא</he>, Rashi <he>כי כי׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) when he shapes the garment so as to form (a kind of) a pocket.

<cite ref="Pesachim 72a:4">Pes. 72ᵃ</cite> <he>ודמי ליה כמאן דמנחא בכִיסְתֵיה</he> and it was to him as if lying in his pocket (ever ready to recite it); <cite ref="Ketubot 50a">Keth. 50ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 7b:9">Meg. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>בכִיסֵיה</he>. [<cite ref="Ketubot 98a:7">Keth. 98ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="K00932"><he>כְּסִיתָא</he></cite>.]
